data.app_name: The Pirate Queen with Lucy Liu
data.description:
Embark on an epic journey through the turbulent waters of history in "The Pirate Queen", with Lucy Liu 🌟

![{"height":224,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38982662_7513468888773292_7586277367396825871_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=cMO_KqlY018Q7kNvgGlR3oN&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAKKB4m-IztnaLGNdCe3Ol39YEM1ZGXmR-qmMf13vrrww&oe=674AF79C)

Step into the boots of the legendary pirate Cheng Shih and see if you have what it takes to become history's most powerful pirate  🏴‍☠️


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39036653_1456869748359051_7076517034930849202_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=M7MSp1XsLFIQ7kNvgFI94M6&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCgaSOYiUutMUjowFUm9T141kZE5kRbH-jGDU9L0tMMKA&oe=674B0124)


Travel back in time with this immersive story, perfect for explorers of all ages. Whether you're seeking a fresh adventure, yearning to escape into another world, or eager to unearth a hidden gem from history, this legend is for you.

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39003263_961033948683270_8273646164126363713_n.png?_nc_cat=111&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=f1mKqG3JUFQQ7kNvgHDH-Uz&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYBiFY8GyJrEl1OugpiQKWH3Aj_2l3frDsr08GApiuD3og&oe=674AE887)

With light gameplay elements, the focus is on the narrative. Dive into a story-rich experience lasting 1-4 hours ⏳, climb rigging, explore moonlit cabins 🌙, unearth hidden artefacts, and exercise your wit to become leader of the Red Flag Fleet.  

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031579_801519894943640_3850714342256227051_n.png?_nc_cat=100&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=XApTrLOA6J4Q7kNvgF95iWX&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAno6Sv-zf101YnBZevxBIqWaZMyGkuHuhoxURGLChTSg&oe=674ADB66)

![{"height":231,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/39031400_1653444588750690_8451663376835143463_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=hvo8j3FG8WYQ7kNvgHMu56U&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYB6iUhhLx0F6HH7Cgl24BYo04Nomz3z1OiR3Vo3S6-g9A&oe=674B07D8)

Celebrated for its cinematic story and historical environments, this non-combat experience has earned critical acclaim, winning the Tribeca Storyscapes Award (2023) & the Raindance Discovery Award (2021) 🏆

![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75322595_315227141608157_6664541123259039926_n.png?_nc_cat=104&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=T20YagAYjVkQ7kNvgHD0Lb6&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYC6_4fz0AcMJTt2gMLTvkcfDtg8s26DEdFgvwwl1LIkKA&oe=674B0459)


![{"height":225,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/38974820_419365674368364_6471370540204954427_n.png?_nc_cat=106&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=ATyK1APDfxUQ7kNvgH642YK&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYAKd3VJt_GFN0shoehqtn1EjOsL2gmWQDjbxzpCloX1YA&oe=674AEA70)

Experience the captivating performance from Hollywood actress Lucy Liu 🎭, who brings Cheng Shih's character to life, under the direction of critically acclaimed filmmaker and creative director Eloise Singer 🎬


![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/57569455_779145490949371_5639970595016054333_n.png?_nc_cat=102&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=O0H6jKI95DoQ7kNvgH5o47V&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYD13Tp3snTVgCa1espZMq-QrIdJJEAtQ0YlJT2mmuFLqA&oe=674B0D2A)

![{"height":244,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75593949_1392764491611640_7662168618929982906_n.png?_nc_cat=108&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=st3Q5E_i4iYQ7kNvgFI3bni&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-1.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYDSH4_WWrVl5WB4xEAAmLH_75LobhZCVTnz4wJDqZNy5A&oe=674AE897)

Are you ready to turn the tides of history? Let's see how well you fare as The Pirate Queen! 🏴‍☠️👑



![{"height":910,"type":"image","width":1559}](https://scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com/v/t64.5771-25/75251817_478868781249664_4666816330504461518_n.png?_nc_cat=105&ccb=1-7&_nc_sid=6e7a0a&_nc_ohc=ANGfpehJl7oQ7kNvgExXblV&_nc_zt=3&_nc_ht=scontent-iad3-2.oculuscdn.com&oh=00_AYCqD8-Rwku2GGF2xSD8CseFiFzKwsOUJpglTJvc9-PENw&oe=674B040C)
